title: New Testament Survey
description: An introduction to the world, literature and message of the New Testament. Students study the historical and cultural background of first-century Judaism and the Greco-Roman world, the four Gospels and the life of Jesus, the growth of the church in Acts, Paul's letters, the General Epistles and Revelation, and the formation of the New Testament canon. The course focuses on each book's purpose, structure and theological contribution.
